final_decision.rationale: Two-step deterministic pipeline: blur_motion:3 -> compression_jpeg:2 (camera order). JPEG severity pinned by 0%FP block_boundary (5/5 pairs). Motion type chosen over gaussian/lens/glass by CI+PSNR. Severity 3 chosen by same-image signal matching (gm/spectral slope/FFT anisotropy); PSNR mode cannot reach LIKELY because the motion kernel direction is re-randomized per simulation (repeat test PSNR 25.65 vs 20.94), capping PSNR at ~24-31 dB. No noise, no global.

signal_reinterpretation.assessment: JPEG confirmed. Severity 2 retained: R0 5-pair CI showed block_boundary error 0-5% at jpeg:2 (sim bb 2.02-2.19 vs target 2.1245); jpeg:4 sim bb=4.01 far above target. No JPEG severity change warranted.

support_validation.change_gate: deterministic candidate requires PSNR > 40 dB or +2 dB vs previous round; observed +0.76 dB -> NOT met
support_validation.kernel_randomness_control: motion kernel direction is re-randomized per call: identical motion:3+jpeg:2 on pair0 scored 28.11 (R1 baseline), 25.65 (R0) and 20.94 (R0 repeat); motion:4 replicate means differed by 2.8 dB (27.37 vs 24.57). Single-run PSNR cannot arbitrate severity; pooled 10-sample comparison shows no reproducible advantage for severity 4.
support_validation.conclusion: Neither PSNR (+0.76 dB < 2 dB) nor CI (9.0 vs 9.0) supports changing motion severity; signal calibration (gm/slope/aniso) favors severity 3. NO_CHANGE.

final_decision.rationale: R1 signal re-interpretation found no ignored/misread signal; the only boundary signals (FFT anisotropy 1.70, residual_intensity_corr gamma flag) are explained/corroborated by independent evidence (PCA=3.58, noiseless-sim reproduction). Motion severity 4 tested twice on all 5 support pairs: pooled 10-sample PSNR 25.97 vs baseline 25.21 (+0.76 dB, below the +2 dB change gate) and identical CI, while gm_ratio/spectral-slope calibration favors severity 3. Keep R0 pipeline unchanged.
